title: The Frequency That Was Already There - Masters X Trilogy
description: Every page of the Distribution File carries f = 111.2 Hz. The number is fiction. The stone under it isn't. Researchers documented a resonance near 110 Hz in Neolithic chambers from Malta to Scotland. I added one decimal so nobody confuses my invention with their measurement.

title: Sound Into Form - The Chladni Plate - Masters X Trilogy
description: The oldest special effect in my trilogy needs no computer. A metal plate. A violin bow. A spoonful of sand. Draw the bow and the sand jumps into a geometric figure. Chladni demonstrated it in 1787. You can do it on your kitchen table tonight.

title: Why Kansas City? Four Traditions, One Riverbank - Masters X Trilogy
description: People assume I set a conspiracy trilogy in Kansas City because I live here. The convenience ran the other way. Around the second century, people on these river bluffs were building stone-vault tombs: rooms with doorways, sealed inside burial mounds. Chamber-building here predates Rome's fall.

title: The Grimoire That Was a Study Aid - Ars Notoria - Masters X Trilogy
description: The medieval Church condemned the Ars Notoria. Not for devil-worship, but for cheating. The manuscript promised the seven liberal arts through contemplation of geometric figures and scheduled prayer. Knowledge without the sanctioned labor of study. It is real. British Library, MS Sloane 1712.
